I am an old man now, 62 years, and this small plot of maize is what feeds my household. I will buy a little fertilizer if the coupon from the government comes through, because without it the soil here in Lilongwe gives very poor yield, but I cannot afford the full amount the extension people recommend. I keep some chickens and goats so I spread their manure on the plot before the rains, and I intercrop with pumpkins and beans to help the soil and give my wife something for the pot. My sons help me when they are not doing piece work, but my back is not what it was, so during weeding time I will pay two young men from the village for a few days.
